verdicts.root_cause: src/modules/equity-overview/EquityOverviewPanel.tsx:227: listedUnderAYear reads only fundamentals.listing_date. sidecar/services/yfinance_provider.py:952 sets that only for .NS symbols, from the NSE master. first_trade_date is on the wire and correct for US IPOs, but it is ignored. So a US or BSE-only listing under 52 weeks old is labelled '52w' and shows a '1Y change'.
verdicts.fix_shape: In EquityOverviewPanel.listedUnderAYear, fall back to the data-start date when there is no exchange listing date: const listed = fundamentals?.listing_date ?? fundamentals?.first_trade_date. The label answers one question: does the provider's 52-week window hold less than a year of data? first_trade_date answers that for every non-NSE listing. An old first_trade_date (NAPEROL 2002-07-01) keeps '52w'. No sidecar or contract change.

The existing listing_date cases stay green. Live: curl :<port>/fundamentals/NAVN returns listing_date null and first_trade_date 2025-10-30, and the Equity Overview panel for NAVN and MDLN reads 'since listing' with no 1Y change.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/macro/ecb_provider.py:177-178 and sidecar/services/macro/world_bank_provider.py:164-167 wrap every upstream exception in ProviderError with no kind. That covers ECB 'REQUEST ERROR 404: No results found', ecbdata's key-parse ValueError, and wbgapi APIError 'JSON decoding error' for an unknown indicator. sidecar/services/macro/imf_provider.py:121 raises a malformed id with no kind. sidecar/routers/macro.py:69,89-101 accepts any provider string and sends a non-Literal one ('worldbank', 'world_bank', 'bogus') to the legacy openbb path. All of these land on the kind=None mapping at services/errors.py:102: 502 provider_error, 'Retry, or try again later.'
verdicts.fix_shape: Classify at the provider raise sites, as imf_provider.py:212-213 already does for an IMF upstream 404. In ecb_provider.get_series, map an ecbdata 404 ('No results found') and a key-parse ValueError to kind='not_found', and a transport error to 'network'. In world_bank_provider.get_series, map a wbgapi APIError for an indicator the WB source does not list to 'not_found', and RequestException to 'network' (search() at :241 already does that). In imf_provider._parse_key, raise the malformed-id error with kind='not_found'. In routers/macro.py, type the series route's provider as MacroProvider | None, as /search and /catalog already do (lines 47, 56). A mistyped provider then gets a 422, and the dead legacy openbb fallthrough (lines 94-101) is removed.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/option_chain.py:181-182: 'if status == "failed": return None' ends the walk on any failed walk-back day. Lines 165-172 and 177-180 consult and write the _probe_key negative cache only when day == today. A transient failure on yesterday's file therefore 502s the chain (get_chain :337/:342, then routers/quant.py:87-88) while an older day sits in cache, and every request re-probes yesterday.
verdicts.fix_shape: In fetch_latest_fo, treat a failed walk-back day the way a failed today-probe is already treated. Replace 'if status == "failed": return None' with 'upstream_down = True; continue'. The walk then goes cache-only and serves the newest cached day, returning None at the end only when nothing is cached. Apply the _probe_key check and record to every probed trading day, not only day == today, so a failed day is not re-probed within _PROBE_TTL_SECONDS.

verdicts.failure_sources: R15-DATA-114: the register note has no 'certification failures so far' clause. Baseline 0: no stage-c not_certified, no refutation-audit partial or regression. +1 for this partial = 1.
verdicts.note: I re-ran the shard's oc114.py in-process at HEAD. Scenario A (the entry's repro: today failed, Mon cached) serves Mon with 1 network call, so it holds. Scenario C (Tue 404, Mon failed, Fri cached) gives [None, None, None] with network calls Tue, Mon, Mon, Mon. The existing option-chain, earnings and macro pins pass (49 passed), and none covers C. This is the tied entry's class (uncached-negative-probe), not a new defect. The title's general claim ('a negative probe ... is never cached, so a transient error can 502 a request while a good cached day sits in cache') and the fix's own docstring intent (option_chain.py:144-151) both still fail, now for the walk-back day. Scenario D shows the code already serves an older cached day when today's probe fails, so C is inconsistent with the fix's contract. The trigger is common for a daily user: before the close, today is always a 404 and yesterday is often uncached. Severity medium, unchanged.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/earnings_provider.py:219 and :253 set the payload currency to info['currency'], the ADR's trading currency. Lines :345 (EarningsEvent), :462/:488 (history entries, and surprises via :528) and :576 (EarningsEstimateDetail) label every EPS field with it; only revenue gets the scale-checked _revenue_currency (:118-146). Yahoo serves per-share EPS for CNY/DKK reporters (PDD, JD, BIDU, TCOM, NVO) in the reporting currency. src/modules/earnings/EpsEstimateGrid.tsx:26-30 then prints it with that label, e.g. '$18.84'.
verdicts.fix_shape: Mirror _revenue_currency for EPS. Add trailing_eps (info['trailingEps'], in the trading currency per ADS) to the payload at :219/:253. Add _eps_currency(payload, quarterly_eps), which returns: the trading currency when quarterly_eps x4 / trailing_eps lies in the existing 0.3-3x band; financialCurrency when it lies outside the band; the trading currency when financialCurrency equals it; and None otherwise (non-positive or missing trailing EPS on a foreign reporter). Use it for the EPS currency at :345, :462/:488 and :576. Type that field str | None in models/earnings.py and types/data.ts, so EpsEstimateGrid prints no currency code for None, as it already does for revenue_currency.

verdicts.note: Same class, so partial rather than a new entry. It is the same seam and surface, and the same currency-mislabel of a reporting-currency money figure labelled with the ADR's trading currency. The entry's root_cause ('sets currency from the trading/ADR currency for every money field') still holds verbatim for EPS. Its fix_shape assumed per-share fields are in the trading currency, which is true for WIT and false for CNY/DKK reporters. The entry's own WIT repro and the round-2 INFY cases hold. Live at HEAD on :52435: PDD eps_estimate_mean 18.84 is labelled USD (revenue_currency CNY), and so are PDD history eps_actual 19.33/9.51/17.69, PDD surprises, and NVO 5.0045 and NVO history. Scale sweep: estimate x4 / trailing EPS is 8.1 for PDD, 5.0 for NVO, 17.3 for JD and 6.4 for TCOM, and BIDU's sign flips. It is 0.9-1.5 for NVS/SAP/ASML/HDB/IBN/INFY.NS/TSM/WIT/AAPL. If PDD's 18.84 were USD its forward P/E would be about 1.0 against a trailing 8.4. Severity raised from the shard's medium to critical: wrong data presented as right. EPS for 5 of 16 ADRs sampled is overstated about 7x in USD terms on the Earnings Calendar Consensus EPS column, the estimate grid, the surprise chart and the agent's earnings tools. The register rated the same-shaped SIFY INR-as-USD mislabel (R15-DATA-008) critical.
